name: Develop and debug GUI applications using Python libraries
description: Users asked to design, implement, or troubleshoot graphical user interface applications and components using Python libraries such as Tkinter, PyQt, and Kivy, as well as MATLAB. Requests ranged from building specific utility apps like calculators, image viewers, and database connectors to resolving widget styling, layout, and event handling issues.
